visual.title: The angle survives an analytic map
visual.caption: Both rays leave z at the same point and the map carries them to new directions. For an analytic map the angle between them is unchanged; the conjugate reflects and flips its sense.

predict.question: Square the plane and carry two rays through z. What happens to the angle between them?
predict.explain: z squared multiplies every tangent by 2z, a rotation with a scale. A common rotation preserves the angle, which is what conformal means.
